summary: Enable Slack thread -> Confluence comment sync with per-channel redaction & retention exemptions
description:
Issue summary:
We need a controlled, auditable automation that replicates Slack thread replies into corresponding Confluence page comments for designated project channels. The sync must support per-channel redaction rules (PII masking or removal) and allow retention exemption flags for legal/compliance channels. The goal is to provide a searchable canonical record in Confluence while preserving Slack channel hygiene and legal requirements.

Impact:
- Product and legal teams need message mirroring for review/archival.
- Current manual copy/paste is error-prone and not audited.
- Must avoid leaking PII or violating retention policies.

Request:
- Build/enable a Slack app + Confluence integration for a configurable set of channels.
- Per-channel configuration UI (or config file): toggle sync on/off; set redaction profile (none, redact-names, redact-emails, custom regex); set retention-exempt flag.
- Create a SCIM-like mapping: for each channel -> Confluence space + page template.
- Include an approval step: only workspace admins or channel owners can enable sync for a channel.
- Provide audit log entries (who enabled, when, config snapshot).

Acceptance criteria:
- New sync can be toggled for #legal-reviews, #comms-press-drafts, and a staging test channel.
- Messages posted in Slack threads are visible as Confluence comments within 60s in staging.
- PII redaction rules applied correctly to test dataset (see test vectors below).
- Audit log shows enable/disable with user and timestamp.
- Retention-exempt channels do not get deleted by automated retention jobs; documented exception created.

Constraints & security considerations:
- Integration must use workspace bot token with least privilege and support token rotation (reference secrets runbook).
- Redaction must run before sync to Confluence; plain text should never store unredacted copies outside Slack.
- Retention-exempt flag must be honored by downstream retention jobs (work with Records team).

Timeline:
- 2-week prototype in staging, then handoff to Platform for review.

Owner / Next steps:
- Platform Eng to review feasibility; Security to review redaction approach; Records to approve retention-exemption flow.

Test vectors:
1) "Please email jane.doe@example.com for details" -> redact email
2) "Bob Smith: SSN 123-45-6789" -> redact SSN by regex
3) Non-PII message remains unchanged

investigation_notes: Checked Confluence REST API: comment POST supports body content and metadata fields; can store 'sync_source' key to mark origin.
Slack Events API supports 'message' subtype 'thread_broadcast' and 'message_replied' events; need to handle edits and deletes.
Retention jobs are orchestrated in Airflow; will need a conditional exemption tag in Confluence comment metadata or page label.
Prototype notes: lambda approach acceptable; consider moving into existing infra function for lifecycle and secrets management.
